parties.respondent: Exide Life Insurance Company Limited & Anr.

summary: Insurance claim repudiation on ground of material suppression; non-disclosure of LIC policies while disclosing Aviva policy; agent-filled form; accidental death; disclosure of Rs.40 lakh Aviva policy misrepresented as Rs.4 lakh; test of material fact: prudent insurer standard; duty of utmost good faith reciprocal; distinction between inadvertent omission and deliberate suppression; reliance on Manmohan Nanda, Rekhaben Nareshbhai Rathod, Satwant Kaur Sandhu, Mahakali Sujatha; policy voidable if material fact suppressed.
legal_provisions_cited: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (Protection of Policyholders' Interests) Regulations, 2002
Manmohan Nanda v. United India Assurance Company Limited & Another, (2022) 4 SCC 582
Reliance Life Insurance Co. Ltd. & Anr. v. Rekhaben Nareshbhai Rathod, (2019) 6 Supreme Court Cases 175
Satwant Kaur Sandhu v. New India Assurance Co. Ltd., (2009) 8 SCC 316
Mahakali Sujatha v. Branch Manager, Future Generali India Life Insurance Company Limited & Another, (2024) 8 SCC 712
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; repudiation of claim set aside; insurance company directed to pay policy benefits with interest.
